request.style: English, choral, male solo with deep choir, organ, cello, timpani, harp, reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Outside the camp we go
Bearing the disgrace he bore
No lasting city here
We seek the one that is to come

[Chorus]
Through him let us continually
Offer to God a sacrifice of praise
The fruit of lips that confess
His holy name before the Lord

[Verse]
Do not neglect to do good
Share with others in your days
Such sacrifices are pleasing
To the God who knows our hearts

[Chorus]
Through him let us continually
Offer to God a sacrifice of praise
The fruit of lips that confess
His holy name before the Lord

[Verse]
Jesus suffered outside the gate
To make the people holy
Through his own blood he cleansed us
From the weight of all our sin

[Chorus]
Through him let us continually
Offer to God a sacrifice of praise
The fruit of lips that confess
His holy name before the Lord

[Bridge]
We have no lasting city
Looking for the one to come
So we offer up our voices
As a sweet and holy sound

[Outro]
A sacrifice of praise
The fruit of confessing lips
Always, always, always
Pleasing in the sight of God
